✨ Describe your icon

Type what you want and it's made for you from everything in the maker. Then change anything you like.

💾 Presets

Save a design and load it again later. Your last design is also remembered automatically on this device.
Presets live in this browser, including your own items, an uploaded background and an uploaded monke base.

🎨 Colours

Quick fur colours

🖼️ Backgrounds

Pick a style. Solid, Spotlight, Sunburst, Stripes, Checker and Dots use your Background colour.
🔒 Got a subscriber code?
Subscribers to my YouTube channel get a code that unlocks a secret background.
⭐ Subscriber background unlocked. Thanks for subscribing!

🎩 Accessories

🧸 Your own items

Add your own things for your monke to wear or hold. PNGs with a transparent background work best.
Drag the item on the preview to move it. Drag the round corner to resize, or the square side handles to stretch it.
Turn it up if some background is left, or down if parts of your item disappear.
Items are saved in presets, and in icons you share to the gallery so remixes get them too.

🗂️ Layers

Choose what's in front of what. The top of the list is at the front. Use ▲ and ▼ to move a layer.

✨ Finishing touches

Use a square or 16:9 PNG with a transparent background. After uploading, you choose which colours are the fur, face, belly and eyes. Your base stays in this browser session.

🧩 Set up your custom base
Press Pick next to a part, then click that part on the preview (or one of the detected colours below). Anything you don't assign stays exactly as drawn.
Detected colours
.png
📺 Channel banner

A 2560 × 1440 YouTube banner that matches your icon: same monke, outfit and background. It updates as you change your design.

🗣️ Talking GIF

Type what you're going to say and your monke talks it: the mouth opens for each part of a word, closes between words, pauses at commas and full stops, and shakes while it talks. There's no sound, so record your own voice over it.

The mouth only opens on the Classic monke base, so this monke will just shake. Switch Monke base to Classic monke to make it talk.

🎬 Video thumbnail

A 1280 × 720 YouTube thumbnail with your monke, big text and a screenshot from your video. It updates as you change your design.

How it looks in YouTube search:

Pause your video on a good moment, take a screenshot and pick it here.

🌍 Community gallery

Icons shared by other monke creators.

Share your current icon
Everyone can see what you share. Don't include personal info like your real name or address.
